decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - REFUSAL for the following reasons:

The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that prior approval will be required for the siting and appearance of the matter as described above within the meaning of Schedule 2, Part 24, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (as amended).

The Authority hereby refuse to grant approval for the following reason:

The proposed siting and appearance of the development is considered to represent an obtrusive feature in the locality the effect of which would unduly impact on the open nature of this area of Metropolitan Green Belt and visual amenity in the area.  The proposal is therefore contrary to policies ENV.1.1, ENV.1.12 and ENV.4.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan; policies ENV-B.1.1, ENV-B.1.7, ENV-N.1.2 and ENV-N.2.2 of the Review Deposit Unitary Development Plan and Planning Policy Guidance Note 8: Telecommunications.
